short_title: Uranium and thorium in beach sand (2025)
title: Spatial Distribution Patterns, Eco-Environmental Risk Assessment, and Human Health Impacts of Uranium and Thorium in Beach Sediments in the Central Gulf of Gabes (Southern Mediterranean Sea)
summary: Mapped uranium and thorium in beach sand. Uranium ranged from 0.71 to 38.00 mg/kg and thorium from 1.00 to 10.60 mg/kg, highest near the fertiliser factories. Phosphogypsum is the likely source.

findings.headline: Uranium in beach sand reached 38 mg/kg, highest near the factories
findings.summary: Uranium in the sand ranged from 0.71 to 38.00 mg/kg, and thorium from 1.00 to 10.60 mg/kg. The highest levels were in the central area near the factories.
